$comment: Limits in bytes for scripts/check-bundle-budgets.cjs. Started at the 2026-11-02 build plus 3%; renderer.entry gzip and main.index raised on 2026-11-14 to that day's main build plus 1%; main.total gzip raised the same day to 1,835.4 kB plus 1% (the spawn census and the /proc process reader, pull request 192); renderer.startup gzip raised the same day to 783.2 kB plus 1% (the git refresh clock, pull request 193); main.index raw and gzip and main.total raw and gzip raised the same day to the budgets job's measure plus 1% (main.index 2,073.6 / 680.9 kB, main.total 5,634.9 / 1,838.4 kB) for the graphics-card switch and its safety net (pull request 196). renderer.entry raw and renderer.startup raw raised on 2026-11-15 to that day's build plus 1% (1,787.0 and 2,737.3 kB) for the rail's paced read round (pull request 199). renderer.entry gzip raised on 2026-11-17 to that day's build plus 1% (543.6 kB, from main's 540.9 kB) for the browser tools' agent-facing results and errors (pull request 230). The Source Control tab strip (pull request 226, which keeps the GitHub block mounted behind its tabs) adds about 0.4 kB gzip to the entry chunk and fits under that limit. renderer.startup gzip raised on 2026-11-17 from 791.0 to 793.0 kB for the Source Control commit box at the top of the Changes tab (pull request 227, measured 791.6 kB). Raised the same day for the Source Control compact lists and their folder-safe discard (pull request 228): renderer.entry raw 1,805.0 to 1,812.0 kB (measured 1,807.0), renderer.startup gzip 793.0 to 795.0 kB (793.2), main.index gzip 688.0 to 690.0 kB (688.2, the folder discard check), preload.total gzip 12.0 to 12.2 kB (12.0, its bridge). Raised the same day for the agent on the user's Chrome page (pull request 234: the stop list Codara keeps, saves and sends to the extension, its failsafe and the give back call) to the budgets job's measure plus 1%: main.index raw 2,095.0 to 2,122.0 kB (measured 2,100.3), main.index gzip 690.0 to 698.0 kB (690.5), main.total gzip 1,857.0 to 1,878.0 kB (1,859.0); its renderer pieces load with Settings and fit under renderer.startup. main.total raw raised on 2026-11-17 from 5,692.0 to 5,751.1 kB (measured 5,694.1 kB plus 1%) for the worker feed: a Cora worker's steps kept per attempt, read by the chat and the message-a-worker call. Raised the same day for the worker rows that open a worker's own chat in Cora (pull request 248: the row button, the open-worker context and the panel's inside-a-worker state; the worker view itself loads lazily): renderer.entry raw 1,812.0 to 1,830.7 kB (measured 1,812.6) and renderer.startup raw 2,765.0 to 2,793.8 kB (measured 2,766.1), each measured plus 1%. renderer.startup gzip raised on 2026-11-18 from 795.0 to 803.1 kB (measured 795.1 kB plus 1%, after main's 2026-11-18 build) for the same worker rows and, above them, the agents rail's mount point and its preload read (pull requests 248 and 257). renderer.entry gzip raised on 2026-11-18 from 549.0 to 555.4 kB (measured 549.9 kB plus 1%) for the agent tool marks in the new-tab picker: each worker row shows its tool's update state and its Update button, which the picker needs as soon as it opens; the Settings section loads with Settings. main.total gzip raised on 2026-11-18 from 1,880.0 to 1,898.3 kB (measured 1,879.5 kB plus 1%, on main with pull request 274) for an agent removing a worktree it made and gave up: the closed pull request lookup and its proof in the removal check, and the asking agent's own tab no longer counted as a use in the cleanup tool. main.total raw raised on 2026-11-19 from 5,751.1 to 5,809.2 kB (measured 5,751.7 kB plus 1%) for the Cora route order (pull request 223): the route choice, its per-run Routes rows, and keeping compaction, turn recovery and worker planning on the chosen route. main.index raised on 2026-11-19 to the budgets job's measure plus 1% (raw 2,122.0 to 2,159.4 kB, measured 2,138.0; gzip 698.0 to 710.7 kB, measured 703.7) for the Firefox link's input and refusals on Firefox tabs (pull request 288, on main with pull request 287: per-tab access stamps and the page-event input played by the extension). preload.total gzip raised on 2026-11-19 from 12.2 to 12.36 kB (measured 12.24 kB plus 1%) for the Firefox add-on's easy install (pull request 294: the bridge calls that copy manifest.json's path and open about:debugging in the user's Firefox). Raise one only in the pull request that needs it and say why; lower one after a size win. renderer.entry raw raised on 2026-11-21 to that day's build (1,831.4 kB) plus 1%: the browser pane's page-backdrop probe (pageBackdrop.ts, pull request 300) put it 0.7 kB over a limit that main already used to 100%. Raised on 2026-11-22 to that day's build plus 1% for the Pi and Antigravity session pickers (pull request 302: agy's conversation list and live conversations read from its summary table, and the --continue guard over every workspace's saved tabs): renderer.entry gzip 555.4 to 561.1 kB (measured 555.5), main.index raw 2,159.4 to 2,183.2 kB (measured 2,161.5) and gzip 710.7 to 718.5 kB (measured 711.4), main.total gzip 1,898.3 to 1,917.4 kB (measured 1,898.3), preload.total gzip 12.36 to 12.51 kB (measured 12.38). renderer.entry gzip raised the same day from 561.1 to 561.3 kB for direct Cora chats (pull request 303): which steps draw as a direct turn, what Find searches in one, and the one diff tab the chat's file links share; the turn itself loads lazily. renderer.startup gzip raised the same day from 803.1 to 811.8 kB (measured 803.8 kB plus 1%, on main at 803.0 kB after pull request 303) for a sleeping agent pane that wakes only when asked (pull request 309): the resume request and wake error on the pane's sleeping mark, the resume key in the terminal session and the navigation target that asks for a resume, which every terminal pane needs; the card itself loads lazily. main.total raw raised on 2026-11-22 from 5,809.2 to 5,868.3 kB (measured 5,810.2 kB plus 1%) for the pane notifier naming a pane by its running agent (pull request 305, on main with pull requests 307 to 309): the walk up the process tree and the screen-guess flag sent with each state. renderer.startup raw raised the same day from 2,793.8 to 2,821.8 kB (measured 2,793.9 kB plus 1%, on main at 100% of the old limit after pull request 305) for agent panes that sleep wherever they are but under the keyboard (pull request 311): which panes are on screen and which has the keyboard, the touch report from each terminal pane and the sweep over every workspace's panes, which the app needs from its first tick. renderer.entry raised on 2026-11-23 to the budgets job's measure plus 1% (raw 1,849.7 to 1,868.4 kB, measured 1,849.9; gzip 561.3 to 567.2 kB, measured 561.6) for Cora rows in the session picker (pull request 320, on main with pull request 319 at 100% of both limits): what kind of run a row is, where it opens, and the delete rule and confirm text, which the picker needs as soon as it opens. main.index gzip raised the same day from 718.5 to 725.8 kB (the budgets job's measure, 718.6 kB, plus 1%; on main with pull request 320 at 99.9%) for restoring a Codex session by its id (pull request 321): the bounded day-folder lookup, the pinned account-folder links and the check that never drops a session on its own failure. main.index raw raised on 2026-11-23 from 2,183.2 to 2,207.3 kB (measured 2,185.4 kB plus 1%) for idle Claude panes that sleep although their status line repaints: the settled-state idle clock, the hourly re-log, the memory read of the pane's process tree and the small-buffer /proc reader that keeps the census from holding 150 MB of read buffers in main.

startup.$comment: Warn levels for scripts/measure-startup.cjs, medians on the GitHub Linux runner (4 CPUs). Report only: crossing one warns, never fails. On 2026-11-02 the runner measured first window 579 ms, workspace visible 960 ms, 640 MB.
